requirements.behavior: A Calendar operator adds, edits one ordinary availability row in place with its ID retained, and removes it for an allowed Person. The screen may update optimistically, but added/updated/removed/saved success messages wait for confirmed persistence. Chosen status, inclusive dates and note agree with the one saved row after reload; failed adds and updates restore accurate state and show an error without losing the prior row, and untouched historical rows remain unchanged.

requirements.behavior: A Calendar configurator creates, renames, recolors and explicitly deletes an ordinary status through settings. Edits retain the existing status identity, persisted sort order and referenced availability; confirmed deletion applies the supported availability cleanup and notification/audit effects. Reload and Calendar labels agree with saved data, and denied or failed operations never appear successful. Ordering preservation is checked at the API/entity boundary; no ordering UI is required.

requirements.behavior: A Calendar configurator creates and edits person- and Group-targeted assignment types and header choice through supported settings, preserving seeded exemptPersonnelIds and saved assignment references during edits. Confirmed ordinary-type deletion deliberately removes assignments referencing that type; unrelated assignments and archived historical types/rows remain unchanged. Referenced archived types remain readable through authenticated Calendar range/bootstrap consumers and excluded from editable choices. Reload retains the chosen fields. No exemption editor is required.

Denial saves no rows and reveals no protected data.
